purpose: Predeclared research protocol; no parameter winner is automatically promoted
data: Dated TWSE daily ALLBUT0999 market cross sections, 2024; prior-session turnover top 40, no fixed symbols
fitting: No model or parameter fit, no maximizing diagnostic returns. Expanding pre-test information only; each test fold starts with 100000 TWD.
baseline: Pinned v0.2.4 programAnalysis source, unchanged, on common safety-corrected execution and authorized limits. This rules baseline is separate from the uploaded AI-policy trades.
integration: E is an explicitly unvalidated combination at predeclared 4%/2-session settings. Production E includes mandatory safety fixes only unless independent evidence supports a feature. All strategy research switches remain OFF.
entry_score: Fixed explanatory components (trend25/momentum15/volume10/volatility10/location10/cost20/regime10); score>=50 and explicit vetoes. Not calibrated win probabilities.
recovery: Cooldown measured in observed open sessions; drawdown must recover below half trigger; loss streak requires cooldown and TREND proxy.
matching: Common daily open/close approximation, next quote only, legal ticks/limits, minimum fee20, fee0.001425, sell tax0.003, T+2 at11:00, no same-day sales; common actual adverse book stress10bps each side, increased to30/50bps in stress cases.
selection_rule: Report every variant/fold including failures. No return guarantee, no statistically validated winner from two folds. Index benchmark is price-only and not an executable security. No paid AI reasoning trials in this offline run.
limitations: Unadjusted daily data cannot validate intraday or real odd-lot alpha
TWSE-only identifier filter is not a verified full historical stock master
An unchanged rules baseline is not an exact rerun of model-selected uploaded trades

exploratory_mechanism_ablation.reason: Separate causal mechanisms; bundled B results had already been observed. These are exploratory ablations, not a newly untouched holdout or parameter-selection evidence.
